messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT P2] Auto-detect: model quality drop detected for model `redwood/latte-1.2`. Deployed ~12:03 UTC. Metric: downstream-eval F1 dropped ~12% vs baseline. Affected: ~5-7% production requests (heuristic). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/1742005432

Priya Patel: ACK. Pulling together evaluation slices and logs. @Miguel Torres can you confirm the rollout timeline and if there were any fast-path changes? ETA 5m.

Miguel Torres: Confirmed rollout timeline — canary -> 25% at 12:00, ramp to 100% by 12:02 via our blue/green job. No infra changes. Observed spike in QA/NER failure counts starting ~12:05. Initiating immediate rollback of model to previous pinned version.

incident-bot: Rollback job created by @Miguel Torres. Command executed: 
```
rdeploy rollback --service model-serving --from redwood/latte-1.2 --to redwood/latte-1.1 --strategy immediate
```

Sara Li: Noted impact on smart-reply and rerank customers. Escalating to CS leads; prepping customer-facing note. @Customer Ops please flag any open tickets from customers in the last 15m.

Nadia Chen (ops): @Priya moving to capture SLI diffs: request_latencies, model_response_quality, error-rate. I'll draft the status page entry and share for review.

Priya Patel: Short mitigation note for ops: pin production to `redwood/latte-1.1` until RCA. Command run: `rconf set model.pin=redwood/latte-1.1 --env prod` — verifying traffic now.

Emily (oncall): Taking ownership for the incident for the next 2 hours (12:20–14:20 UTC). Handoff to @Jake (SRE) at 14:20. I'll keep the runbook open.

Miguel Torres: Rollback complete at 12:18 UTC. Canary rebalanced to `redwood/latte-1.1`. Initial quality metrics trending back toward baseline but we'll monitor for 30–60m. No infra errors reported.

Jake (SRE): I'll watch infra (GPU OOMs, queue depth) and the inference runtime logs for any anomaly. If we see a recurrence, we'll re-open the rollback and page the escalation policy.

Nadia Chen (ops): Draft status page update (please review/paste):
```
Status: Service degradation (Mitigated)
Impact: Some users experienced lower-quality generated responses after a model update at 12:03 UTC.
Current status: Traffic rolled back to previous model (redwood/latte-1.1) at 12:18 UTC. Quality metrics are returning to baseline.
Next update: within 60 minutes or as new information becomes available.
```

Priya Patel: Customer notification (short template) — use for broad inboxes and status page: 
```
Subject: Brief service update — model update rollback

We detected an issue with a recent model update that temporarily affected response quality for a subset of requests. We have rolled back to the previous model version and service levels are returning to normal. We will continue monitoring and follow up with a detailed update if you were impacted. If you need immediate assistance, contact support@redwood.ai.
```

Sara Li: High-touch customers copy (CS teams): 
```
Hi {CustomerName},

We’re reaching out to let you know we briefly deployed a new model which caused degraded output quality for some requests. We rolled the deployment back as soon as we detected it and have restored behavior to the prior model. We’re investigating root cause and will share an RCA and timeline by EOD. Please let us know if you observed specific failures — logs or example prompts help.

Apologies for the disruption,
Sara (on behalf of Redwood Inference)
```

Priya Patel: Operational notes and next steps: 1) Keep production pinned to `redwood/latte-1.1` until RCA completed. 2) Run targeted evals on the failing slices (QA, NER, short-answer) against both 1.1 and 1.2. 3) If RCA points to data-dependent model change, prepare a staged canary with stricter guardrails (hold at 5% and run 30m A/B tests).

Miguel Torres: Adding immediate triage items to the incident board: reproduce failure locally, compare tokenizer outputs between versions, unit test generation on failing prompts, check quantization path diffs.

Nadia Chen (ops): Severity confirmed P2. I'll open a postmortem ticket and assign Priya and Miguel as leads for the RCA. Draft postmortem owner: Priya Patel (RCA) + Miguel Torres (deploy/process).

incident-bot: Incident state -> MONITORING at 12:30 UTC. If quality metrics deviate >5% again, page: @pagerduty-escalation.

Priya Patel: reassigning follow-ups: postmortem skeleton created here: https://boards.redwood.ai/incidents/1742005432 — add logs and eval artifacts. I'll drop initial RCA notes by EOD.

Sara Li: CS action: emailing top 10 accounts with the high-touch template; copy of message posted to this thread for audit.

Miguel Torres: For deploy hygiene: propose adding an automated eval gate pre-rollout that runs our synthetic suite and blocks rollout if score regression >3% on any critical metric. Will draft a PR for the deployer.

Emily (oncall): Closing loop for my shift: monitoring looks stable for now. Tagging Jake for overnight watch.

Jake (SRE): Acknowledged. Will keep a light watch and escalate if needed.

Customer Ops: Received 2 inbound tickets referencing poor quality—linked to the incident and flagged as impacted. CS assigned to follow up.

Priya Patel: Summary note to include in postmortem: timeline, mitigation (rollback & pin), affected customers estimate, follow-up remediation (pre-rollout eval gate + canary hold policy).

incident-bot: This thread archived to incident log ID 1742005432. If you need to re-open, reply with `reopen` and an owner.
